name: Shadowbolt
body:
School evocation [electricity]; Level sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 60 ft.
Area 60-ft. line
Duration instantaneous; see below
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

A line of crackling, black lightning erupts from your fingertips. Any creature struck by a shadowbolt takes 1d6 hp damage per caster level (maximum 10d6), split evenly between electricity and negative energy damage (which is not subject to resist electricity).
